build_optimizer: build an SGD optimizer from a Detectron2 config node and PyTorch model with gradient clipping support
build_lr_scheduler: build a learning rate scheduler with warmup multi-step or cosine decay from a Detectron2 config
get_default_optimizer_params: get default optimizer parameter groups for a model with configurable weight decay for norm layers and bias
maybe_add_gradient_clipping: wrap an optimizer class to add per-parameter or global gradient clipping by value or norm
reduce_param_groups: reduce and merge duplicated optimizer parameter groups to speed up PyTorch multi-tensor optimizer performance
